## Project Instructions
Django project for restaurant management and online food ordering with delivery service.

### Features
- User authentication and authorization
- Restaurant management (add, edit, delete restaurants)
- Menu management (add, edit, delete menu items)
- Online food ordering system
- Cart management
- Delivery service management
- Order tracking and history
- Notifications for order status updates
- Online payment integration
- Admin dashboard for managing users, restaurants, and orders
- Subscription-based management access for restaurant owners
- Review and rating system for restaurants and menu items
- Recommendation system for users based on their preferences and location
- Logs for monitoring user activities and system events


## Coding style
- Follow PEP 8 style guide for Python code.
- Use meaningful variable and function names.
- Write docstrings for all functions and classes using google style.
- Use type hints for function parameters and return types.
- Avoid using global variables.
- Use list comprehensions and generator expressions where appropriate.
- Handle exceptions gracefully and provide informative error messages.
- Follow senior django developer's best practices for Django projects.
- Use Django's built-in features and libraries whenever possible.
- Write reusable and modular code to improve maintainability and scalability.
- Use separation of concerns principle
